$comment: THE V8 CONTRACT. Approved by Reid 2026-10-08 and FROZEN.
These three files are the design authority for Command Center V8. They were
copied BYTE-FOR-BYTE out of
C:\Users\manag\Documents\ARCHITECTURAL FLASHING SUPPLY WEBSITE\cc-compare
after their sha256 hashes were verified against the hashes Reid approved in
the V8 Phase 0 instruction. Nothing was reformatted, minified, prettified or
re-saved on the way in.
scripts/audit/contract-check.mjs re-hashes every file listed here on every
build (it is wired into `prebuild`, beside contrast-check), so an edit to a
contract file fails the build rather than silently becoming the new design.
RE-BASELINING IS NOT A NORMAL OPERATION. The only way to change a hash in
this file is scripts/design/rebaseline-v8-contract.mjs, which refuses to run
unless the environment carries CONTRACT_APPROVED_BY_REID=1. No Claude Code
session may set that variable; it exists so the act of changing the frozen
design is Reid's, recorded in a shell he typed it into.
The `sourcePath` field records where each file came from. It is informational
only — the gate hashes the committed copy under docs/, never the source
folder, which is outside the repo and may change.
